description: For a well-founded relation R, a property holds at every element if its truth at all R-predecessors of an element implies its truth at that element.
signature:
WellFounded.induction.{u} {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Prop} (hwf : WellFounded r) {C : α → Prop} (a : α)
  (h : ∀ (x : α), (∀ (y : α), r y x → C y) → C x) : C a
